newsitem.title: USA: Purus motion seeks to freeze its assets.
newsitem.headline: Purus motion seeks to freeze its assets.

text.p: Purus Inc said plaintiffs who filed a class action lawsuit against the company in July 1995 are seeking a preliminary injunction to freeze the company's assets or impose a trust on them.
The motion aims to block a proposed $3.00 per share distribution that the company is paying to shareholders, Purus said in a statement issued late Friday.
Purus said it will defend its right to pay the distribution, pending shareholder approval at the company's annual meeting on December 5, 1996.
The lawsuit that was filed in 1995 accuses the company of violations of securities laws, Purus said.
